core_materials: Opening representative spike: all evaluators see failed PCS option, cable maintenance liabilities, handset inventory, and card paperwork; 강재현 proves they are one phone-number and monthly-bill gate.

First reward retention: restructuring committee observer seat, 72-hour sale freeze, limited data-room access, carrier procurement direct line, first maintenance order, handset distribution test, billing pilot code, PCS voting proxy, and PC communication acquisition review right must stay visible across the opening bundle.
Authority gain route: ignored branch grandson -> restructuring-room observer -> carrier procurement contact -> regional handset distribution tester -> billing pilot owner -> PCS voting proxy holder.

Opening macro battlefield: 태림그룹 IMF telecom scrap sale, spanning committee table, PCS option documents, base-station maintenance field, handset warehouse, card billing contract, legal memo, and JV proposal.
Core asset anatomy: PCS residual voting right, 태림전선 maintenance SLA, 태림전자 low-end handset inventory, 태림유통 regional stores, 태림카드 billing relationship, 태림미디어 PC communication option.

Clean control path: internal restructuring access must convert into documented freeze, committee seat, legal memo, pilot code, carrier order, or voting proxy before any asset is treated as protagonist-controlled.

Repeatable loop: discarded telecom asset -> gate relevance read -> present proof -> same-block authority/access receipt -> bundle into 태림모바일서비스 -> recurring fee or control right -> wider sector entry.
Self-interest law: 강재현 keeps teams and subsidiaries only when they preserve phone number, network uptime, handset acquisition, billing continuity, settlement speed, store execution, or legal defense.
TR pacing law: each block is a 2-6 episode bundle and needs at least two incident beats plus a same-block receipt.
All-sector expansion law: every new sector must enter through phone number, monthly bill, handset distribution, settlement, user data, enterprise messaging, or retail channel.

crisis_pool: 태림그룹 will sell PCS option, maintenance unit, handset inventory, and billing line separately within 72 hours.
Foreign fund attempts to buy the PCS residual option before 강재현 freezes the sale.
Carrier procurement team rejects 태림전선 maintenance unit as overpriced and obsolete.
Base-station outage creates a proof window but also a public failure risk.
Handset inventory can become dead stock if no regional distribution test is won.
Legal team blocks phone-bill bundled service billing as regulatory and consumer-risk exposure.
Main-family executive tries to take credit and leave 강재현 with implementation risk.
Card billing pilot fails if settlement table, complaint handling, and carrier cooperation are not documented.
PC communication acquisition option disappears if the billing pilot does not create a next-gate token.
Charity-rescue drift threatens to keep useless subsidiaries that do not support the gate.
hard_constraints: No TR before Stage 0, Phase 0, and work_guard freeze.
No BI before accepted TR draft.
Every TR block must be treated as roughly 2-6 downstream episodes, not one episode.
Every TR block must contain at least two distinct incident beats and a same-block receipt.
강재현's actions must be legible as profit, efficiency, legal protection, speed, leverage, control, defense, survival, retaliation, or next-gate position.
Future knowledge cannot replace present proof through documents, logs, contracts, carrier calls, field capacity, or billing records.
Opening 2-6 cannot use block 1 or block 7+ as delayed rescue.
Early rewards must be authority/access/legal receipt before large cash.
No charity-rescue engine; saving people or operations must preserve value or accelerate execution.
do_not_fake: Do not fake telecom as generic platform vibes; use phone number, monthly bill, base-station maintenance, handset acquisition, billing settlement, or carrier procurement.
Do not fake carrier proof with a vague executive call; use SLA, outage, procurement line, maintenance order, marketing slot, or pilot agreement language.
Do not fake billing legality; use billing contract, fee table, complaint handling, legal memo, pilot code, or settlement schedule.
Do not fake handset distribution; use warehouse stock, store region map, purchase order, regional test, or marketing slot.
Do not handwave PCS voting control; show residual option, voting proxy, committee freeze, creditor approval, or JV proposal.
Do not replace deal proof with future-knowledge monologue.
Do not turn staff retention into saintly rescue; it must defend maintenance, distribution, billing, settlement, or legal execution.
Do not pay a block with praise only; pay with authority, access, legal protection, cashflow, or next-gate position.
